videos.title: What To Do With Your Life
videos.summary: Figuring out what to do with your life often feels paralyzing because the question is too broad, but breaking it down into a structured framework turns abstract anxiety into actionable clarity. In this video, you'll discover a practical 3-part blueprint—spanning life-area mapping, limitless dream planning, and the transformative 5-year 'Odyssey Plan'—to uncover what truly drives you. If you feel stuck between career paths or unsure of your next move, this step-by-step guide delivers the exact journaling exercises you need to find your direction.
